ceu: ✦ The opposition between Mercury and Saturn

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.
From {H:1824045894000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to home and family.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between relationships and your image. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to someone you come across.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.
From {H:1824045894000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between routine and your inner life. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
From {H:1824045894000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between romance and friendships. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
From {H:1824045894000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between family and your career. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
From {H:1824045894000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between conversations and your horizons. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.
From {H:1824045894000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between money and intimacy. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
From {H:1824045894000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between your image and relationships. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
From {H:1824045894000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between your inner life and routine. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
From {H:1824045894000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between friendships and romance. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Do not try to change the other person: try to understand them.

t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
From {H:1824045894000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between your career and family. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Start the day with the hardest task and the rest will feel light.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
From {H:1824045894000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between your horizons and conversations. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Laugh at yourself when something goes less well.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
From {H:1824045894000}, the Moon moves into {S:3} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.
The opposition between Mercury and Saturn creates some tension between intimacy and money. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Make peace with a childhood memory.
